text_zh:
上海发布发布加强科技金融服务
20条措施，量子计算明确纳入科创板第五套标准
7月23日，上海市委金融办等九部门联合发布《上海市充分发挥直接融资功能进一步加强科技金融服务的若干措施》（共20条）。其中明确提出：推动科创板持续深化改革，将可控核聚变、具身智能、大模型、量子计算、脑机接口等新兴产业和未来产业领域企业纳入科创板上市通道，持续扩大科创板第五套上市标准的适用范围（允许未盈利企业上市），增强资本市场对前沿科技领域未盈利企业的制度包容性与适应性。
来源：
https://jrj.sh.gov.cn/zwdt-tz/20260723/8304eadf87034b39b7aeb770bbc38a66.html
IBM拟收购HRL实验室，推动量子计算研究
7月23日，IBM已签署收购HRL实验室协议，通过HRL在硅自旋量子比特工程、传感和先进材料方面的专业知识，扩展其量子计算研究能力。HRL的研究人员和技术将补充IBM现有的超导量子比特工作，同时支持量子计算、量子传感和量子网络领域的工作。HRL现任所有者波音和通用汽车，将在收购后继续与IBM合作，开展量子应用和先进技术开发。
来源：
https://newsroom.ibm.com/2026-07-23-ibm-to-acquire-hrl-laboratories-to-power-the-future-of-quantum
以色列创新局启动
1亿新谢克尔征集，建设国家量子计算研发基础设施
7月20日，以色列创新局发起了1亿新谢克尔征集提案，旨在建立一个国家级的量子计算研发基础设施，为产业界和学术界提供多种量子计算平台的访问。规划中的基础设施将整合至少三项量子处理技术，支持基准测试、应用开发、算法研究和技术评估。该倡议旨在通过连接拥有先进量子计算能力和专业知识的研究人员、企业和初创企业，加速以色列的量子应用。
来源：
https://innovationisrael.org.il/en/press_release/quantum-infrastructure/
英国政府将人工智能置于内阁层面，
DSIT被解散
7月21日，据BBC报道，英国政府已废除科学、创新与技术部（DSIT），同时提升人工智能部长卡尼什卡·纳拉扬进入内阁，表明人工智能将成为核心优先事项，同时对包括量子技术在内的其他先进技术的监管也将进行重组。此次重组引发了英国如何协调其长期量子战略的疑问，因为此前由DSIT管理的职责将分散到多个政府部门，尽管现有的国家量子项目仍然存在。扩大对人工智能基础设施的投资，包括计算能力、数据中心和能源供应，也可能有利于量子计算，因为这两个领域都依赖共享的高性能计算资源、先进半导体技术和专业科研基础设施。
来源：
https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cz97x8k4zqzo
美国能源部宣布首批创世纪任务项目入选，以加速人工智能驱动的科学发现
7月22日，美国能源部已选定278个项目进行其创世使命的授标谈判，旨在开发基于人工智能的科学工作流程，旨在加速能源、发现科学和国家安全领域的研究。所选项目组合包括由国家实验室、大学、企业和非营利组织主导的项目，研究领域涵盖核能、关键矿产、智能芯片设计和商业聚变能源等。获奖者将获得使用Genesis使命平台的访问权限，该平台结合了人工智能工具、先进软件和高性能计算资源，支持新型人工智能驱动研究方法的开发与测试。
来源：
https://www.energy.gov/articles/secretary-energy-chris-wright-announces-first-genesis-mission-projects-selected-accelerate
白宫新科学战略《科学：新的黄金时代》，指向一种量子式创新模式
7月21日，白宫的新科学战略《科学：新的黄金时代》勾勒出一种强调使命驱动研究、公私合作伙伴关系、制造业和区域生态系统的新模式，这一框架与量子产业已经发展的程度高度契合。该政策主张，未来美国技术领导地位将依赖于研究、工程、制造、劳动力发展和商业化之间的更紧密联系，这些原则已体现在许多量子项目中。报告指出，量子领域在新的联邦科学战略下可能处于有利位置，因为其许多现有的生态系统建设实践与政府目前倡导的制度性方法相符。
来源：
https://www.whitehouse.gov/science/
不筹量子发布
“量筹一号”，首创“三算力融合”异构架构
7月18日，WAIC 2026会上，上海不筹量子科技有限公司发布“量筹一号”——国内首款原子量子人工智能基座（Q-Cub）。该产品首创“三算力融合”异构架构，集成中性原子QPU（执行量子线路、提供量子加速）、GPU集群（量子态仿真与AI推理训练）与经典CPU（业务对接与编译调度），由自研“量筹调度”统一编排、透明切换。基于三算力融合架构，“量筹一号”已构建八大应用生态，如气象量子智能、VLA具身智能、化工新材料研发、量子纠错等。

不筹量子与上海期智研究院、复旦大学宣布，成立中性原子量子智能实验室
7月18日，WAIC 2026会上，上海不筹量子科技有限公司与上海期智研究院、复旦大学共同宣布成立中性原子量子智能实验室。实验室聚焦智能量子纠错、量子储层计算与容错量子智能三大主攻方向，依托复旦大学李晓鹏教授团队在量子机器学习领域的原创性理论积淀，结合上海期智研究院在人工智能与算法工程化方面的深厚积累，以及不筹量子在中性原子量子计算硬件工程化上的领先优势，打造国家级“量智融合”创新策源地。
来源：
https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/sm099zHRJvjzzwmP_eYKZg
中器无量发布算力中心级中性原子量子计算机
“清河一号”
7月18日，据科创板日报报道，WAIC 2026会上，中器五无量发布算力中心级中性原子量子计算机“清河一号”。清河一号在量子比特数、读取保真度、门保真度等指标方面，达到国际一流水平，可以实现量子经典混合的计算操作系统、实时原子图像处理、高速AI纠错解码等功能。清河一号面向算力中心进行整机设计，可直接部署于现有计算集群，接入CPU/GPU等经典算力，统一调度、协同计算。在应用场景上，将面向材料组合优化、人工智能等任务，提供可调用、可验证、可持续迭代的量子算力服务。
来源：
https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/lDVTMyXklqYpaYsXtdboIQ
图灵量子发布行业级量子
-经典混合Agent平台QAgent
7月18日，WAIC 2026会上，图灵量子正式发布全球首个基于光量子技术路线、面向行业场景的量子-经典混合Agent平台QAgent。该平台首次实现“自然语言输入、任务智能拆解、量子Agent协同调用、量子算力调度、结果聚合与输出”的端到端闭环。可一句话调用量子算力，推动量子计算进入Agent调用时代。QAgent集成图灵量子在生物医药、金融科技、交通物流、教育科研、电力能源、网络通信六大领域的量子能力，已接入超100项量子-混合行业工具技能。
来源：
https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/iJQykYKASondxNHrch5Wdw
两仪万象完成数亿元
A+轮融资，君联资本领投
7月19日消息，近日，两仪万象科技有限公司完成数亿元A+轮融资。本轮融资由君联资本领投。新增投资机构包括北京基石创投、上海科创基金、北洋海棠基金和中信建投投资，形成了一个由地方、财务和券商等多元化机构组成的投资矩阵。A轮的投资方顺为资本和科大讯飞持续加注，展示了刘庆峰等民族实业派企业家对两仪万象的认可和对其成长的长期支持。

Bloch Quantum Tech Hub筹集5500万美元，用于建设美国量子供应链
7月20日，Bloch Quantum Tech Hub宣布获得近5500万美元的公私资金支持，其中包括3000万美元的美国经济发展署资助，用于在伊利诺伊州、威斯康星州和印第安纳州建立国内量子制造供应链。这一资助将帮助量子公司扩大制造规模、将区域制造商整合进量子供应链、加强技术安全，并在伊利诺伊量子与微电子园区开发新的供应商设施。该资助建立在美国扩大国内量子制造和减少对进口零部件依赖的更广泛努力基础上，联邦和州领导人将中西部的制造基础和研究生态系统定位为未来量子生产和就业增长的基础。
来源：
https://chicagoquantum.org/news/cqe-led-bloch-quantum-tech-hub-raises-55-million-build-us-quantum-supply-chain
Interlune开发低温技术，以扩大氦-3量子计算供应
7月20日，Interlune展示了其冷捕获技术通过低温分离方法，能够从A级氦中生产99%纯度的氦-3。该公司表示，该技术有望增加美国氦-3在包括超导量子计算系统在内的应用中的可用性。Interlune正在开发用于地面氦气处理的冷捕获技术，同时瞄准未来从月球资源中提取氦-3。

BTQ Technologies与TIDAL PWR合作，开发可信量子数据中心参考框架
7月20日，BTQ Technologies与TIDAL PWR宣布合作，开发未来人工智能、高性能计算和量子计算基础设施的可信量子数据中心参考架构。该合作将聚焦于量子数据中心设计原则、后量子安全要求、采购标准及部署框架。这些公司旨在帮助数据中心运营商为将量子系统与现有先进计算基础设施整合做好准备。
来源：
https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/btq-technologies-announces-strategic-collaboration-with-tidal-pwr-to-advance-trusted-quantum-data-center-architecture-302829410.html
IQM与德国铁路合作，在真实运营数据上演示量子算法用于铁路调度
7月20日，IQM和德国铁路（Deutsche Bahn）展示了一种混合量子-经典方法，利用真实的铁路调度数据在当前量子硬件上解决大规模优化问题，提供了可跨行业应用的框架。该项目使用了真实的德国铁路数据集，涵盖了跨越五个德国城市的190次行程，约98500个可能的调度周期，QAOA在较大的经典工作流程中解决了较小的优化子问题。研究人员发现，该方法在当今硬件上产生了可行的解决方案，随着更大量子子问题的处理能力提升，并完成了IQM量子计算机的完整优化流程。
来源：
https://iqm.tech/press-releases/iqm-and-deutsche-bahn-demonstrate-quantum-algorithm-for-railway-scheduling-on-real-operational-data/
中科量枢完成天使及天使
+轮融资，布局量子计算全栈式软件生态
7月20日消息，近日，源自中科院计算所的量子计算操作系统及算法平台公司中科量枢宣布，完成了天使及天使+轮融资，各数千万元人民币。天使轮融资由普华资本、知壹投资联合领投，九坤创投跟投。天使+轮由北工量子基金独家投资。该公司的定位是，将量子计算与AI深度融合，构建链接底层硬件与上层应用的量子核心基础设施。

Maybell Quantum将建立新墨西哥州业务，作为新墨西哥州4.5亿美元量子计划一部分
7月21日，Maybell Quantum宣布计划在新墨西哥州Roadrunner量子实验室建立运营，为该州的量子生态系统增添低温基础设施和本地就业岗位。公司将在该设施部署四台稀释冰箱，为量子初创企业和研究人员提供低温测试能力。Maybell与Qunnect和QuEra Computing一起，成为为新墨西哥州4.5亿美元量子计划贡献基础设施的量子公司。

Innolume订购Veeco GEN2000 MBE系统，扩大量子点激光器制造
7月20日，Innolume订购Veeco的GEN2000分子束外延（MBE）系统，以扩大砷化镓基量子点激光器在光互连应用中的生产。此次投资旨在满足硅光子学、光学收发器和AI数据中心基础设施中量子点激光器日益增长的需求。Innolume还采用了Veeco的Spectro离子束沉积系统，以增强其在光子器件制造中的内部激光涂层能力。

IonQ和QuantumBasel研究表明，混合量子-经典AI模型具有潜在能量优势
7月20日，IonQ和QuantumBasel研究发现，混合量子-经典AI模型在特定经典方法上匹配甚至胜出，同时在更大尺度上展现出潜在能量优势。对IonQ Forte Enterprise系统的测试发现，量子能量的使用与量子比特数量呈线性增长，预计与GPU仿真交叉约为34个量子比特。结果仅限于一种工作负载、一种硬件配置和量子推断，需要更广泛的测试来验证其优势。

问天量子与海光信息合作，发布国内首款一体化抗量子机密计算安全平台
7月20日消息，近日，在2026“上海信息技术应用创新产业发展论坛”安全分论坛上，问天量子联合海光信息发布国内首款一体化抗量子机密计算安全平台。该平台将问天量子在量子密码领域的深厚积累与海光信息领先的国产硬件机密计算能力深度融合，首次实现量子安全与硬件机密计算的一体化，补齐国产算力底层安全短板，精准对接AI、政务、金融、医疗、能源等行业的数据安全刚需，被视为抗量子密码从标准储备期迈向规模商用期的标志性落地。
来源：
https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/iB2fBACUVGN5JRV_YSMSog
DIS和DSTA与IBM合作，探索量子计算用于任务规划和物流优化
7月21日，新加坡武装部队（SAF）数字与情报局（DIS）与国防科学技术局（DSTA）与IBM合作，探索量子计算方法以应对任务规划和物流优化挑战。此次合作将为DIS和DSTA工程师提供使用IBM量子计算资源的实践经验，以评估潜在应用。该倡议旨在提升新加坡国防生态系统中的量子计算专业知识，并评估未来的运营应用场景。

Galaxy启动Galaxy Bitcoin量子准备计划，保护比特币的加密基础
7月21日，Galaxy Digital宣布启动Galaxy Bitcoin量子准备计划，最高可获得500万美元资金用于量子安全研究、开发者资助和咨询委员会。该倡议旨在支持评估和应对比特币加密基础设施潜在量子计算风险的工作。Galaxy的项目将聚焦于后量子密码学研究、迁移工具，以及与研究人员和比特币开发者的合作。

Photon Queue筹集400万美元超额认购种子轮，以扩大量子存储系统规模
7月21日，Photon Queue宣布已筹集了由Playground Global牵头的超额认购400万美元种子轮融资，旨在加速其室温量子存储技术的开发与部署，该技术适用于量子计算和网络系统。该公司表示，其量子存储器能够存储和同步单个光子，无需低温、真空系统或量子传导，并且设计用于多种量子计算平台，包括光子计算、离子阱和中性原子系统。Photon Queue已在桑迪亚国家实验室和马里兰大学部署了首批商业系统，基于2024年从伊利诺
伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校分拆出来后获得了客户的早期关注。

SAXON Q发布基于钻石的商用NV-Center量子计算系统
7月21日，SAXON Q宣布其基于钻石的SXQ128和SXQ512亿造蜂器中心量子计算系统已商业化上市，这些系统可在室温下运行，无需低温冷却或真空基础设施。这些系统采用SAXON Q的钻石制造和多核架构，支持包括化学仿真、优化和量子机器学习在内的量子工作负载。公司表示，其NV-center平台专为可扩展量子计算部署设计，现有系统可供订购，未来将扩展到更大规模的架构。
来源：
https://www.linkedin.com/posts/saxonq_quantumcomputing-frontiertech-diamond-activity-7485376583600627713-jE5F
Quantinuum与软银公司发布白皮书，将实用量子计算用例扩展至容错时代

# Weekly Report | Shanghai Issues 20 Measures to Strengthen Science and Technology Financial Services, Quantum Computing Explicitly Incorporated into STAR Market Fifth-Set Listing Standards; IBM Plans to Acquire HRL Laboratories, Hedging Its Bets on Quantum Computing……

## Shanghai Issues 20 Measures to Strengthen Science and Technology Financial Services, Quantum Computing Explicitly Incorporated into STAR Market Fifth-Set Listing Standards

On July 23, the Shanghai Municipal Financial Working Committee and eight other departments jointly released the *Several Measures of Shanghai Municipality on Fully Leveraging the Function of Direct Financing to Further Strengthen Science and Technology Financial Services* (comprising 20 articles). The document explicitly proposes: advancing the continuous deepening of STAR Market reforms, incorporating companies in emerging and future industries—including controlled nuclear fusion, embodied intelligence, large models, quantum computing, and brain-computer interfaces—into STAR Market listing channels, and continuously expanding the scope of application of the STAR Market's Fifth-Set Listing Standards (which permit unprofitable companies to list), thereby enhancing the institutional inclusiveness and adaptability of the capital market toward unprofitable companies in frontier technology sectors.

## IBM Plans to Acquire HRL Laboratories to Advance Quantum Computing Research

On July 23, IBM signed an agreement to acquire HRL Laboratories (HRL Laboratories, LLC), expanding its quantum computing research capabilities through HRL's expertise in silicon spin qubit engineering, sensing, and advanced materials. HRL's researchers and technologies will complement IBM's existing superconducting qubit work, while also supporting efforts in quantum computing, quantum sensing, and quantum networking. HRL's current owners—Boeing and General Motors—will continue to collaborate with IBM following the acquisition on quantum applications and advanced technology development.

**Source:**

## Israel Innovation Authority Launches 100-Million-New-Shekel Call to Build National Quantum Computing R&D Infrastructure

On July 20, the Israel Innovation Authority (以色列创新局) issued a call for proposals totaling 100 million new shekels, aimed at establishing a national-level quantum computing R&D infrastructure that provides industry and academia with access to multiple quantum computing platforms. The planned infrastructure will integrate at least three quantum processing technologies, supporting benchmarking, application development, algorithm research, and technology evaluation. The initiative aims to accelerate quantum applications in Israel by connecting researchers, enterprises, and start-ups possessing advanced quantum computing capabilities and expertise.

## UK Government Elevates AI to Cabinet Level; DSIT Dissolved

On July 21, the BBC reported that the UK government has abolished the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT) and elevated AI Minister Kanishka Narayan (卡尼什卡·纳拉扬) to Cabinet rank, signaling that artificial intelligence will become a core priority. Governance of other advanced technologies—including quantum technologies—will also be restructured. This reorganization has raised questions about how the UK will coordinate its long-term quantum strategy, as responsibilities previously managed by DSIT will be distributed across multiple government departments, although the existing National Quantum Programme remains in place. Expanded investment in AI infrastructure—including computing capacity, data centers, and energy supply—may also benefit quantum computing, as both fields rely on shared high-performance computing resources, advanced semiconductor technology, and specialized scientific research infrastructure.

## U.S. Department of Energy Announces First Genesis Mission Projects Selected to Accelerate AI-Driven Scientific Discovery

On July 22, the U.S. Department of Energy selected 278 projects for award negotiations under its Genesis Mission, aimed at developing AI-based scientific workflows to accelerate research in energy, discovery science, and national security. The selected project portfolio includes initiatives led by national laboratories, universities, companies, and nonprofit organizations, spanning research areas such as nuclear energy, critical minerals, intelligent chip design, and commercial fusion energy. Awardees will receive access to the Genesis Mission platform, which combines AI tools, advanced software, and high-performance computing resources to support the development and testing of novel AI-driven research methods.

On July 21, the White House's new science strategy, *Science: A New Golden Age*, outlined a new model emphasizing mission-driven research, public-private partnerships, manufacturing, and regional ecosystems—a framework that closely aligns with the current state of development of the quantum industry. The policy contends that future U.S. technological leadership will depend on closer linkages among research, engineering, manufacturing, workforce development, and commercialization—principles already embodied in many quantum programs. The report notes that the quantum sector may be well-positioned under the new federal science strategy, as many of its existing ecosystem-building practices are consistent with the institutional approaches the government is currently advocating.

## Research Highlights

### Bavarian Academy of Sciences and Others Detect Stochastic Entry of Individual Abrikosov Vortices in Type-II Superconductors

This study reveals the impact of the Abrikosov vortex entry process in type-II superconductors on the performance of superconducting quantum devices. The research team employed a flux-tunable cavity optomechanical platform, combining a superconducting aluminum nanostring with a SQUID (superconducting quantum interference device) microwave resonator, to detect mechanical resonance frequency changes induced by individual or small numbers of quantized vortices. The experiment resolved vortex pinning behavior and energy characteristics, establishing a connection between vortex dynamics and device performance degradation, thereby providing an important basis for the design and stability optimization of superconducting quantum circuits. Published July 18 in *Nature Communications*.

**Source:**
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-026-75676-4

---

### Entropica Labs (Singapore) and Others Propose SWAP-Gate Embedding Strategy to Preserve Fault Tolerance of Arbitrary Circuits

This study proposes a general strategy for embedding arbitrary circuits on connectivity-constrained quantum hardware while preserving fault-tolerance properties through the design of SWAP gate schemes. Hardware connectivity constraints require long-range gates to be routed via SWAP gates; however, SWAP gates introduce errors and alter error propagation characteristics, potentially compromising fault tolerance. The proposed scheme applies to arbitrary circuits—including logical operations and error correction circuits—and preserves fault-tolerance properties throughout the embedding process. Performance evaluation using surface code embedding on heavy-hexagonal and hexagonal lattices shows negligible noise impact. The strategy provides a direct and practical compilation pathway for realizing fault-tolerant circuits on current hardware. Published July 20 in *Physical Review Research*.

**Source:**
https://journals.aps.org/prresearch/abstract/10.1103/crv2-99qd

---

### Beijing Institute of Technology and Others Achieve Image Classification Using Discrete Time Crystal Quantum Reservoir

This study proposes a gradient-free, noise-robust quantum reservoir computing algorithm using a discrete time crystal as the reservoir. The research characterizes the reservoir's memory, nonlinearity, and information-scrambling capabilities, revealing their connections to dynamical phases and non-equilibrium phase transitions. For ten-class classification tasks, noisy simulation and superconducting quantum processor experimental results are consistent with ideal results; accuracy increases with system size and exhibits topological robustness. This work provides the first experimental demonstration of digital quantum simulation-based quantum reservoir computing in image classification, and validates the relationship between many-body non-equilibrium phase transitions and quantum machine learning performance, offering robust and efficient design principles for the NISQ era. Published July 20 in *Physical Review Applied*.

**Source:**
https://journals.aps.org/prapplied/abstract/10.1103/w2w9-c944

---

### North Carolina State University Simulates Distributed Transversal CNOT and Teleportation

This study simulates the circuit-level behavior of two distributed primitives—transversal non-local CNOT and logical teleportation—for surface codes and bivariate bicycle codes, and tests them in subroutines of general quantum algorithms. The study is implemented using the scalable library Transversal Multiple Code Block Simulator. Within all physical channels, CDMFT-hierarchy Bethe-Salpeter equations (BSE) satisfying Ward identities are self-consistently derived, with numerical BSE calculations performed for the half-filled 2D Hubbard model at moderate coupling. Results show that short-range correlations cause the two-particle irreducible vertex in the charge channel to diverge at weaker coupling, which is a necessary precursor to the Mott instability in 2D CDMFT. Both the vertex divergence and the Mott transition are driven by short-range antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations, while the Mott transition itself occurs at stronger interaction. Published July 23 in *Physical Review Research*.

### Beijing Institute of Technology Upgrades Quantum State Verification to a Prescriptive Framework

This study elevates quantum state verification (QSV) from a diagnostic tool to a prescriptive framework that directly specifies optimal measurement schemes and fidelity metrics without requiring full state tomography. The paradigm is experimentally implemented using a three-qubit non-stabilizer W state and an improved homogeneous QSV protocol. Verification measurements not only certify the prepared state with high confidence but also serve as a tomography-free metric system guiding the preparation process. The study achieves high-fidelity preparation consistent with full tomography using only 9 measurement settings and 10⁴ samples, while the latter requires orders-of-magnitude more resources. Furthermore, the prescriptive structure of QSV is naturally compatible with closed-loop feedback, providing a pathway to true real-time quantum state preparation on low-latency platforms. Published July 23 in *Physical Review Applied*.

### Indian Institute of Technology Realizes Bright, Low-Two-Photon Single-Photon Source Using Nanowaveguide-Coupled NV Center

This study demonstrates efficient coupling of a single NV (nitrogen-vacancy) center in a diamond nanowaveguide to guided optical modes, achieving enhanced single-photon output at low two-photon probability. By optimizing excitation and collection geometries, a single-photon count rate of approximately 2 Mcps is obtained, with a two-photon probability as low as g⁽²⁾(0) = 0.014 ± 0.004. The nanowaveguide architecture overcomes the alignment and bandwidth limitations of resonant cavities, providing a scalable and process-compatible pathway toward bright single-photon sources. Published July 23 in *Physical Review Applied*.
